scenarios.title: Interview Preparation
scenarios.prompt: Prepare me for a technical interview.
scenarios.description: Builds a study plan, sample questions and technical topics from a synthetic job description.

scenarios.title: Email Assistant
scenarios.description: Drafts a synthetic email, checks policy, waits for your approval, then simulates sending.

scenarios.title: Weekly Planning
scenarios.description: Reads your session memories and the synthetic calendar, then time-blocks a productive week.

scenarios.title: Research Assistant
scenarios.description: Assembles a synthetic research brief; adds an Analytics pass when the topic has a scoring matrix.

scenarios.title: Document Analysis
scenarios.description: Extracts text, key fields and evidence from a bundled synthetic document, plus a glossary from Research.

scenarios.title: Travel Planning
scenarios.description: Picks a fictional destination, drafts an itinerary, checks the calendar and asks before holding it.

scenarios.title: Simulated Online Booking
scenarios.prompt: Book the Stardust Suites room for me.
scenarios.description: Simulates browser navigation from fixtures, fills a form, and asks before any simulated submission.

scenarios.title: Personal Memory
scenarios.prompt: Remember that I prefer deep-work blocks in the morning.
scenarios.description: Validates and stores a harmless preference in this browser session's memory.

default_params.text: I prefer deep-work blocks in the morning.

scenarios.title: Project Planning
scenarios.description: Builds a dependency-aware task plan and computes its critical path.

scenarios.title: Multi-Agent Collaboration
scenarios.description: Nova plans which specialists to recruit; the Supervisor routes conditionally to each of them.

scenarios.title: Memory Recall
scenarios.prompt: What do you remember about me?

scenarios.title: Schedule a Meeting
scenarios.description: Checks conflicts, suggests a free slot, and asks before adding a simulated appointment.

scenarios.title: Document Redline
scenarios.prompt: Add a review note to a document.
scenarios.description: Proposes a deterministic redline and asks before applying it to the session copy.
